build_ml_backend: build an ML backend model to connect a machine learning server URL to a labeling project
test_ml_backend_healthcheck: test the ML backend healthcheck method to verify connectivity to the ML server
run_ml_backend_predict_tasks: run the ML backend predict_tasks method to generate predictions for a list of tasks
review_ml_backend_interactive_annotating: review the ML backend interactive_annotating method for real-time preannotation support
summarize_ml_backend_train: summarize the ML backend train method that triggers model training and creates train jobs
